newsitem.title: USA: Matritech reaches pact to sell in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Matritech reaches pact to sell in Spain.

text.p: Matritech Inc said Wednesday it has reached an agreement with Barcelona-based Diagnostic Grifols to distribute the Matritech NMP22 bladder cancer test kit in Spain and Portugal.
Diagnostic Grifols is a division of Grupo Grifols, a $180 million medical products company.
The company said it already has marekting partners to sell the product in Asia, other European counties, the Middle East and South Africa.
The NMP22 Test Kit measures the amount of NMP22 protein, which has been show to appear in high levels in people with bladder cancer, the company said.
Martitech said the Federal Drug Administration in July approved the sale of the test kit in the United States for use on certain patients after surgery.

The company said it holds an exclusive license for using proprietary nuclear matrix protein technology, discovered at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, to develop and commercialize serum-, cell- and urine-based tests to detect and monitor bladder, colorectal, cervical, prostate lung and breast cancers.
